Its usage as a Christian name may have been influenced by the tradition of dedicating children to God with the name Theo, as found in the Bible when the parents of Samson promised to dedicate his life to God with the name Theo (Judges 13:16).

It is a reminder of our dependence on God and our gratitude for the gift of life. The name Théo embodies the belief in the Christian faith that God is the Creator and Sustainer of all things. It is a name that inspires us to live in a God-centered way and to strive to live up to the divine gift bestowed upon us.
